svg.text: Authored proposal from raw seed 731 · river town terminus on a retained embankment · passenger and freight worlds meet
Developed initial spatial proposal · phase 1 · invented station · no independent review, AML, navigation or gameplay validation
Provisional dimensions; plan north is up. Rail platform datum z=0.00 m.
Footprint approximately 128 × 96 m across the playable station precinct; the lower public/working loop is drawn on the companion sheet.
Rooms, track separation, levels, planted anchors and sightline screens are hypotheses for a subsequent independent spatial-interest review.
